source: Express Entry: Who can apply (CEC / FSW / FST) + Rural and Francophone Community Immigration Pilots (RCIP): Work experience
note: quote-anchored:valueText=官方原文,本脚本每轮验证其仍逐字在页面上;字段语义见 basis。requirements 形状对齐 raw/ircc/pgwp_rules.json(09 IN_REQ_TABLES 可直接消费)。selectionFactors = FSW 67 分制的官方表格(与 CRS 排名分是两套分,官方明确写明不同)。其中教育档来自 fed-ee 缓存命中的 ECA 报告解读页;criterion=ECA assessment result、heading=EE profile 教育档、points=FSW 教育分(最高 25),没有把 CRS 教育分混入。RCIP(program=RCIP)不是 Express Entry 项目、不参与 CRS,只是同表落 province='FED' 的经验门槛;来源是 Rural/Franco 两条 pilot 各自的 Work experience 官方页(文案逐字相同,已交叉核验),不是 fed-ee 那 97 页种子(RCIP 走 fed-rcip crawl slug)。

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: be in 1 or more of these NOC categories: training, education, experience and responsibilities (TEER) 0, 1, 2, or 3
requirements.label: CEC: skilled work experience must be TEER 0/1/2/3

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: be at least 1 year of work or 1,560 hours total (30 hours per week) in the 3 years before you apply
requirements.label: CEC: 1 year (1,560 hours) of Canadian skilled work in the 3 years before applying

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: be gained by working in Canada while authorized to work under temporary resident status
requirements.label: CEC: experience must be gained in Canada while authorized to work

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: Self-employment and work experience gained while you were a full-time student
requirements.label: CEC: self-employment and full-time-student work experience do not count

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: There is no education requirement for the Canadian Experience Class
requirements.label: CEC: no education requirement

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: You must plan to live outside the province of Quebec
requirements.label: CEC: must plan to live outside Quebec

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: TEER 0 or 1 CLB 7 NCLC 7
requirements.label: CEC (TEER 0 or 1): CLB/NCLC 7 in all 4 abilities

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: TEER 2 or 3 CLB 5 NCLC 5
requirements.label: CEC (TEER 2 or 3): CLB/NCLC 5 in all 4 abilities

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: be in 1 of these TEER categories: 0, 1, 2, or 3
requirements.label: FSW: skilled work experience must be TEER 0/1/2/3

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: be at least 1 year of continuous work or 1,560 hours total (30 hours per week)
requirements.label: FSW: 1 year of continuous work (1,560 hours)

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: have been obtained within the last 10 years, in Canada or abroad
requirements.label: FSW: experience obtained within the last 10 years, in Canada or abroad

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: If you score 67 points or higher , you may qualify for the Federal Skilled Worker Program
requirements.label: FSW: 67 of 100 selection-factor points to qualify

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: a completed educational credential and an Educational Credential Assessment for immigration purposes
requirements.label: FSW: foreign education needs a completed credential + ECA

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: You don't need proof of funds if you: are currently able to legally work in Canada, and have a valid job offer from an employer in Canada
requirements.label: FSW: proof of funds required unless legally able to work in Canada with a valid job offer

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: You must plan to live outside the province of Quebec
requirements.label: FSW: must plan to live outside Quebec

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: Language Minimum level for all 4 abilities English CLB 7 French NCLC7
requirements.label: FSW: CLB 7 (NCLC 7) minimum in all 4 abilities, first official language

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: Major Groups 72 (excluding Sub-Major Group 726), 73 , 82 , 83 , 92 , or 93 (excluding Sub-Major Group 932) Minor Group 6320 Unit Group 62200
requirements.label: FST: experience must be in the listed NOC major/minor/unit groups

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: be at least 2 years of full-time work experience (or 3,120 hours total) in a skilled trade within the 5 years before you apply
requirements.label: FST: 2 years (3,120 hours) of full-time skilled-trade work in the 5 years before applying

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: a valid job offer of full-time employment for a total period of at least 1 year, or a certificate of qualification in your skilled trade issued by a Canadian provincial, territorial or federal authority
requirements.label: FST: needs a >=1-year full-time job offer OR a Canadian certificate of qualification

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: There is no education requirement for the Federal Skilled Trades Program
requirements.label: FST: no education requirement

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: You must plan to live outside the province of Quebec
requirements.label: FST: must plan to live outside Quebec

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: English Speaking and listening CLB 5
requirements.label: FST: CLB/NCLC 5 for speaking and listening

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: English Reading and writing CLB 4
requirements.label: FST: CLB/NCLC 4 for reading and writing

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: you need at least 1 year (1,560 hours) of related work experience in the past 3 years
requirements.label: RCIP: 1 year (1,560 hours) of related work experience in the past 3 years

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: not be from a self-employed job
requirements.label: RCIP: self-employed work does not count toward the experience requirement

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: TEER 0 or 1: CLB 6
requirements.label: RCIP: TEER 0 or 1 job offer needs CLB 6

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: TEER 2 or 3: CLB 5

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: TEER 4 or 5: CLB 4
requirements.label: RCIP: TEER 4 or 5 job offer needs CLB 4

selectionFactors.heading: Adaptability (maximum 10 points)
selectionFactors.criterion: Your spouse or partner's language level Your spouse or common-law partner has a language level in either English or French at CLB 4 level or higher in all 4 language abilities (speaking, listening, reading and writing). To get these points, you must submit your spouse or common-law partner's test results from an approved agency when you apply. The language tests are valid for 2 years after the date of the test result. They must be valid on the day you apply for permanent residence.
selectionFactors.column: Maximum 10 points

selectionFactors.heading: Adaptability (maximum 10 points)
selectionFactors.criterion: Your past studies in Canada You completed at least 2 academic years of full-time study (in a program at least 2 years long) at a secondary or post-secondary school in Canada. Full-time study means at least 15 hours of classes per week. You must have stayed in good academic standing (as set out by the school) during that time.
selectionFactors.column: Maximum 10 points

selectionFactors.heading: Adaptability (maximum 10 points)
selectionFactors.criterion: Your spouse or partner's past studies in Canada Your spouse or common-law partner completed at least 2 academic years of full-time study (in a program at least 2 years long) at a secondary or post-secondary school in Canada. Full-time study means at least 15 hours of classes per week, and your spouse or partner must have stayed in good academic standing (as set out by the school) during that time.
selectionFactors.column: Maximum 10 points

selectionFactors.heading: Adaptability (maximum 10 points)
selectionFactors.criterion: Your past work in Canada You did at least 1 year of full-time work in Canada: In a job listed in TEER category 0, 1, 2 or 3 of the NOC And, with a valid work permit, or while authorized to work in Canada
selectionFactors.column: Maximum 10 points

selectionFactors.heading: Adaptability (maximum 10 points)
selectionFactors.criterion: Your spouse or common-law partner's past work in Canada Your spouse or partner did at least 1 year of full-time work in Canada on a valid work permit or while authorized to work in Canada.
selectionFactors.column: Maximum 10 points

selectionFactors.heading: Adaptability (maximum 10 points)
selectionFactors.criterion: Arranged employment in Canada You earned points for having arranged employment .
selectionFactors.column: Maximum 10 points

selectionFactors.heading: Adaptability (maximum 10 points)
selectionFactors.criterion: Relatives in Canada You, or your spouse or common-law partner, have a relative who is: living in Canada 18 years or older and a Canadian citizen or permanent resident This relative must be a: parent grandparent child grandchild your or your spouse's sibling (child of your or your spouse's parent) your or your spouse's aunt or uncle (by blood or marriage) your or your spouse's niece or nephew (grandchild of your or your spouse's parent)
selectionFactors.column: Maximum 10 points
